svg.title: Broad Daylight: the CASTAWAY saver control panel
svg.desc: A platinum control panel window. Modules: Sea Turtles (selected), Bottle Returned, Cat on a Crate, Coconut Crab, Leave Any Time, Signal Hunt, Shark Nodding, Parcel Drone, Ticker Tape. Sliders: Turtles, Something happens (four timers from 2 minutes to 6 hours), She is busy (a third), and Darkness, greyed out and locked: always daytime.
